question: Who discovered that diborane reacts with aldehydes and ketones to produce dialkoxyboranes, Which are hydrolysed by water to produce alcohols?
solution:
The correct answer is __**HC Brown.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• ** HC Brown:-**

 
 
• **Herbert C. Brown was a noted British-born American chemist.**
 
• He is best known for his work with organoboranes, a class of chemical compounds that contain a direct bond between carbon and boron. 
 
• Brown earned a B.S. degree in 1936 from Wright Junior College and then pursued his Ph.D. in Chemistry from the University of Chicago, which he received in 1938.
 
• **He discovered that diborane reacts with aldehydes and ketones to produce dialkoxyboranes.**
 
 

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• **Hugo Rudolph Kruyt :-**

 
 
• He was a Dutch chemist who significantly contributed to the field of colloid chemistry.
 
• Kruyt is known for his pioneering work in surface chemistry and is considered a founder of colloid science in the Netherlands.
 
 
 
• **Arthur Stoll:-**
 
 
• He was a Swiss scientist and chemist
 
• He is known for his significant contributions to the field of biochemistry, especially with regard to alkaloids.
 
 
 
• **Arne Tiselius:-**
 
 
• He was a notable Swedish biochemist who was awarded the Nobel Prize for Chemistry in 1948 for his groundbreaking research on electrophoresis and adsorption analysis.
 
• His pioneering techniques laid the foundation for later work on separation and purification methods for complex substances, especially proteins, in the biochemistry field.
